topic.title: FAST-DS 2026: Have undisclosed overseas crypto assets? Know the ₹1 crore and ₹5 crore threshold rules before you disclose
topic.source_snippet: If you're managing cryptocurrency on international exchanges without disclosing them in India, the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers – Disclosure Scheme, 2026 (FAST-DS 2026) could be essential for you. This piece delves into the necessary steps for declaring foreign digital assets and discusses the consequences of failing to disclose crypto investments, highlighting potential tax liabilities and legal safeguards.

news_analysis.headline_hook: FAST-DS 2026: Have undisclosed overseas crypto assets? Know the ₹1 cro
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: The Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers – Disclosure Scheme, 2026 (FAST-DS 2026) outlines procedures for Indian taxpayers to declare undisclosed foreign crypto assets held on foreign exchanges. The guidelines detail reporting steps, tax liabilities, and legal safeguards based on specific threshold rules.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Do crypto holdings on international exchanges remain hidden from Indian tax authorities without reporting?
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Non-disclosure of foreign digital assets exposes taxpayers to tax liabilities and legal consequences, whereas FAST-DS 2026 provides a formal pathway and legal safeguards for declaring these assets.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Audit international crypto exchange accounts and verify total asset value against the ₹1 crore and ₹5 crore FAST-DS 2026 disclosure thresholds prior to filing taxes.
